reviews.text: I explained it was an emergency because my dog's hind legs were immobile, but they said they were fully booked. The receptionist's attitude was so bad it brought me to tears.
My bunnies are being treated there! I think it's a very trustworthy clinic!!

The doctor accurately analyzes the cause of symptoms and provides appropriate treatment. Their explanations are thorough and easy to understand, giving the impression that they are very knowledgeable.

Therefore, I have been a patient there several times. This time, based on the symptoms, an X-ray of the nose was taken. When the dog returned from the examination, as you can see in the picture, the skin was reddish-black and there was extensive bruising around the neck. When I pointed out the bruising, the doctor said the dog had resisted the examination and the cone had rubbed against it; what a troublesome dog. If this were a human child, would the doctor say the same thing if the dog returned from the examination and the doctor explained the bruising? I suspect it's due to the way the dog was held, so I would like the nurses to learn more about proper restraint techniques.

The first picture shows the normal skin color.

My dog ​​is always well taken care of. He is a trustworthy veterinarian who is always willing to give advice on even the smallest of matters and is very kind to my dog! Thank you to the reception staff for always being so courteous. When my dog ​​had his tongue cut at another grooming salon, you responded quickly and were very helpful. From now on, I will be taking Dr. Hayashi for all my grooming needs. Thank you for your continued support.

PS: My dog ​​recently celebrated his first birthday without any problems. I am so happy that he was able to celebrate his birthday in good health. Thank you so much as always.
I get the impression that he is a kind teacher who is cheerful and easy to talk to.

As others have written, I felt this veterinarian was overbearing.

This is especially noticeable when a patient shows a reaction they don't like. It gives the impression that they deliberately say and do things that the patient dislikes.

This tendency is also evident in the copy-pasted responses to critical comments in the reviews here.

The staff exhibits a similar tendency.

I think it might be okay for people who are good at dealing with veterinarians or who happen to get along with them.

I will never use this clinic again.

We always rely on your clinic for our dog and rabbit. This time, our rabbit had severe diarrhea and we had to rush her in for an emergency. Even though it was a holiday and outside of regular hours, the vet happened to be at the hospital and kindly agreed to see her. I can't express how grateful I am that we were able to have our regular vet examine her, even though it was an inconvenient time. We are truly thankful for your help. Thanks to you, our dog is now 18 years old. Thank you very much.

Last month, shortly after moving and before we'd settled on a vet, my dog ​​started vomiting. We took him to another clinic once, but he didn't recover, so we rushed him to this hospital. Even though it was evening, the doctor and nurses examined him carefully and provided treatment. Of all the veterinarians we've been to, they explained things the most clearly and proceeded while observing my dog's condition, so I felt completely at ease. Thanks to them, my dog ​​has recovered completely. Thank you very much.

For nearly eight years, my beloved cat has been receiving treatment here since she was a kitten.

I was always humbled by the thorough explanations of her symptoms and treatment plans, wondering if it was alright for them to dedicate so much time to me. This allowed me to consult with them with complete confidence.

I truly wanted to continue having my cat treated here for her entire life, but unfortunately, moving has made it impossible.

I am also incredibly grateful to the staff; they went to the trouble of finding a pet-friendly taxi company when I moved, and they gently managed my cat during examinations to prevent her from becoming agitated.

I would highly recommend this animal hospital.

The vet was excellent. I'm not sure if they were receptionists, nurses, or assistants, but several female staff members left a very bad impression. When I tried to make another appointment, they said it was fully booked without even checking. When I asked questions, they just said they didn't know without even checking with someone else. When I left, they ignored me even though I paid tens of thousands of yen. At the very least, they could have said "thank you" or "take care." There's another animal hospital nearby, so I'm never going back here again.

You can see the guinea pigs.
The prices are reasonable.

My eldest and second daughter dogs received excellent care here.

We were able to care for them with the director, who was very attentive to and respectful of the dogs' feelings, and we were able to give them a good farewell. Both of them loved the hospital.

When treating illnesses and injuries, the director diligently studies new medications and techniques and explains them in a way that even laypeople can understand.

They listen to the owner's thoughts and feelings and trust them, so you can talk about anything.

We now have three cats, so we will continue to bring them here for a long time to come.

The photo shows my second daughter dog in the waiting room.

I've been using their services since I was referred by a friend who lives nearby.
Consultations are by appointment only, so I don't have to wait long, and they thoroughly examine my pet's condition, so I can leave it in their care with peace of mind.

I also occasionally use their pet hotel services, and if my pet gets pee on them, they shampoo their paws, so they often come back looking even cleaner than when I left them, and I almost feel bad because the fees are so low.

Their grooming fees are also reasonable, inexpensive, and the staff are very good, so it's a big help.

Worst!

I understand that she likes to talk, but she's so unintelligent that when I was discussing my pet's treatment while she was suffering right in front of me, she started talking about another patient's case.

I wish they would consider the patient's feelings when providing treatment.

The previous nurse was a mood-maker and very considerate, but it's a shame that the current one is so inconsiderate!

At a second opinion consultation, within 5 minutes of the examination, an ultrasound revealed splenic cancer and a heart problem. I was referred to the university hospital affiliated with Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology. The next day, I went for a check-up, and splenic cancer and metastasis to the heart were confirmed. The doctors at both hospitals said, "Why are you only doing this much?"

13 days later, she crossed the rainbow bridge.

I am considering legal action with my representative, including criminal (fraud?) and civil charges.

Thank you for visiting our clinic.

We also appreciate your valuable feedback.

My puppy was only six months old, but a groomer noticed excessive thirst and urination—something I hadn't even realized—and after undergoing various tests to find the cause, they discovered a rare vascular condition called a congenital portosystemic shunt.

It was a difficult surgery, but thanks to their swift coordination with a surgical specialist, my puppy was able to return home safely.

I believe this was possible because they addressed my puppy's body shape issues and excessive thirst, which my local, more upscale animal hospital hadn't noticed.

Furthermore, their consultation fees and surgery costs are very reasonable.

This is a hospital I would like to have my dog ​​accompany me for the rest of his long life.

We used the pet hotel service for our hedgehog.

It was our first time using the service, and we had some concerns, but the veterinarian and staff were very kind and attentive, allowing us to leave our beloved pet in their care with peace of mind. The veterinarian also patiently explained things we didn't understand during the examination.

Thank you so much for everything!

They explain things very clearly.

The consultation fees are also reasonable and the billing is transparent.
